notes: Comoros levies a Taxe sur la Consommation (TC), not a VAT: standard rate 10% (CGI art. 152, per the Ministry of Finance tax-expenditure report 2024). Bullion coded 10: the reports official inventory of TC exemptions by HS chapter omits chapter 71 entirely, and no derogatory measure covers precious metals; caveat - the consolidated CGI text was not openable. Silver 10/10. Duty null.
